goal: Go through a complete short interview, from the greeting to the goodbye.

phrases.text: It is nice to meet you.

meaning.roman: Aap se mil kar khushi hui.

phrases.example: Good afternoon. It is nice to meet you.
One of my strengths is staying calm.
My task was to write the first part of the report.

phrases.text: Could you tell me more about ...?

meaning.roman: Kya aap mujhe ... ke baare mein mazeed bata sakte hain?

phrases.example: Could you tell me more about the team?

roleplay.tutor_line: Good afternoon. Please come in. Tell me about yourself.

task.roman: Salam karein aur apna taaruf karayein: naam, shehr aur taleem.

roleplay.model_answer: Good afternoon. It is nice to meet you. My name is Sana Ali and I am from Islamabad. I have a degree in economics and I like working with people.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why are you interested in this job?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap yeh job kyun karna chahte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I am interested in this job because I like solving problems. I also want to learn from a good team.

roleplay.tutor_line: What is one of your strengths?

task.roman: Apni ek khubi batayein aur misaal dein.

roleplay.model_answer: One of my strengths is staying calm. For example, I stayed calm when my group had a problem before a presentation.

roleplay.tutor_line: Tell me about a time you worked in a team.

task.roman: Team ka ek mauqa batayein: aap ki zimmedari aur natija.

roleplay.model_answer: In my final-year project, my task was to collect data and write the first part of the report. We finished on time.

roleplay.tutor_line: When can you start, and do you have any questions for me?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap kab se kaam shuru kar sakte hain, phir ek sawal poochein.

roleplay.model_answer: I can start from next month. Could you tell me more about the first month for a new person?

roleplay.tutor_line: Thank you for coming today. That is all from my side.

task.roman: Shukriya ada karein aur khushi se rukhsat hon.

roleplay.model_answer: Thank you very much for your time. It was nice to meet you.

review_notes: The interviewer ends with 'That is all from my side' on purpose: it says nothing about the result. Keep it that way.
